description:
Functional specifications/files: add a thin Mattermost posted-frame integration suite through WebSocket receiver callback, bridge state/adapter, identity resolver, routing, NodeRouter, Agent, persistence and OpenAIStub. Mock only external Mattermost and LLM HTTP.
Tests first: grouped disabled/optional/required Alice/Bob policy matrix; required without global; provider 401 no fallback; personal replacement/revocation; policy/global changes; assert resolved Person, selected Agent, exact Authorization and persisted answer/error.
Branches: valid DM ingress, Person identity match, routing rule, personal/global/no grant, targeted invalidation, lazy recreation.
Mocking: existing Mattermost request stub plus OpenAIStub; no internal identity/router stubs. Deterministic PubSub/outbound completion barriers; no sleeps.
Docs: clarify receiver boundary does not test WebSocket establishment if needed.
Action reuse: not applicable — integration coverage invokes existing channel/Engine/Agent operations and adds no production Action/tool.
title: [zaq-jrg.44] Mattermost ingress Person credential integration matrix
